status: DRAFT (not registered; SPEC_SHA256 unpinned, skillset_sha256 and code_sha256 unfilled)
move_rule: registered_utc is the first 00:00Z at least 24 h after the registration commit (spec pin + ledger entry), never earlier than 2026-10-25T00:00Z; if the commit slips, registered_utc and t_freeze_utc move to the next qualifying 00:00Z, end = registered + 21 d, label cutoff = end + 21 d, analysis = cutoff + 12 h; the move uses no data and is recorded in the ledger (the frozen set does not change: every HB1 outcome was known by 2026-10-15)

expected.note: from the planning census (challenger R1 fix list); the freeze refuses, before writing anything, if the built set differs or any known outcome is at or after the limit

skill.rule: wallet_skill.build_profiles_batch(profile_trades, resolutions, t_freeze) then snapshot_frame: eligible n_pos >= 5, skilled = top 10% of eligible by skill_score with skill_z > 0; positions only in markets whose outcome was known strictly before t_freeze (closedTime + 48 h); truncated markets and post-close prints excluded (wallet_skill_dev.profile_trades)

matching.rule: same batch (same receipt clock), non-skilled wallet (any profile status), first trade of its (wallet, market) in the batch, not used as a control before, same side (BUY/SELL), same trade-price bucket, same trade-age bucket (receipt - trade ts), same time-to-end bucket (origin Gamma end_date - receipt: <1 d, 1-3 d, 3-14 d, >14 d; missing or past end = no control), same prior_visible flag (the wallet has a strictly earlier trade in that market among the sample's raw rows, computed before the seen-before filter; an add or close rather than a first-seen open), other market and other event (a control with an empty event id is never accepted as another event); up to n_controls by sha256(parent signal id | candidate id) order

universe.rule: entry status two_sided; capture start - due <= max_entry_delay_s; copied-token ask in [ask_min, ask_max]; spread <= spread_max; Gamma end date of the entry row <= entry receipt + max_days_to_end days; final Gamma record (resolved or 50/50) fetched at or before label_cutoff_utc, else censored. Primary set = universe copies of skilled signals capped at the first max_per_wallet_day per wallet per UTC receipt day (receipt order; controls follow their parent); the uncapped universe is a secondary

costs.impact: per-leg $100 buy impact = tier MEAN of cost_model_calibration_v1.json main.books.tier.<tier>.buy100_impact_c by the entry row's Gamma liquidity
costs.per_copy: net per share = pay_j - ask_j - impact - taker fee at (mid_j + h); stake per share = ask_j + impact; equal to cost_check(...).taker_resolution_cost_ps (pinned by a unit test)
costs.exit: hold to resolution (no exit leg); the 24 h secondary exits by crossing at the exit capture's bid

inference.statistic: ratio R = sum(net) / sum(stake) over copies (one share each); E026-C: R_skilled - R_controls, controls averaged within their parent signal
inference.clusters: event_id of the entry row (falls back to the signal's event id, then the market id)
inference.p_rule: one-sided p = max(cluster-bootstrap p by event, cluster-robust t p by event with G - 1 df, two-way event x wallet t p with min(G) - 1 df); E026-C adds two terms from the control-side event dependence: each pair's linearised score is split into a skilled piece (the skilled copy's event) and one piece per control (that control's event, weight 1/m), summed by event regardless of side, then the cluster-robust t p (G_comb - 1 df) and the event bootstrap p resampling these combined event clusters
inference.negative_rule: Not supported (effects >= materiality_floor_ppd excluded) when the upper bound is below the floor, upper = max(bootstrap 97.5% quantile, estimate + t_0.975 * se_event, estimate + t_0.975 * se_twoway), and for E026-C also the combined-event bootstrap 97.5% quantile and estimate + t_0.975 * se_combined_event

census_gates.fixed: 2026-10-21, before any census number (LIVE_TESTS_COPY.md 7.6); counts and entry quotes only, sidecar arm, primary set at L = 0, projected linearly to 21 days from the usable batches read
census_gates.rule: G1 = projected primary-set copies >= g1_min_copies and events >= g1_min_events; G2 = projected pairs >= g2_min_pairs and pair events >= g2_min_pair_events. G1 and G2 pass: register E026-N and E026-C (k = 2). G1 passes, G2 fails: E026-C is dropped before the pin (k = 1, recorded in the ledger). G1 fails: not registered as designed; a redesign needs a written justification and a new review. G3 (planning MDE of E026-N with event correlation 1 <= 0.10 $/$) does not block; a failure adds the label 'low-power (a null is uninformative)'. Gates are 2 x the analysis floors to leave room for censoring and rate drift; they are never changed after the census.
